review_type: Codex explicit per-candidate text review, not human sign-off or scene validation
decision: Retain useful candidates; close this qualification without retries. Structural generation works, but semantic completeness is insufficient for full-catalog release.
comparison_limit: Model size, quantization, runtime and schema changed together; not an isolated capacity effect.
lexical_screen_limit: Spaced Red Bull triggers red-color flags even though the product name is preserved. No keyword flag substitutes for text review.
